title: Unreachable GroupedColumnsTab branch — the apiInput Columns-tab render path is dead after Bundle 3a added API_INPUT to NO_COLUMNS_TAB
description: The Columns-tab render region branches on `nodeType === NODE_TYPES.API_INPUT` to render `<GroupedColumnsTab/>` instead of `<ColumnsTab/>`. That inner branch can never execute. Reaching line 1021 requires the outer guard `activeTab === "columns" && showColumnsTab` (line 1020) to be true, and `showColumnsTab = isKnownNodeType && !isInstance && !NO_COLUMNS_TAB.has(nodeType)` (line 666). Since `NO_COLUMNS_TAB` explicitly contains `NODE_TYPES.API_INPUT` (line 73), `showColumnsTab` is always `false` when `nodeType === API_INPUT`, so the API_INPUT ternary arm at 1021-1027 is unreachable. This is the exact leftover of the Bundle 3a change documented in the file's own comment (lines 61-71): API_INPUT was deliberately added to NO_COLUMNS_TAB to remove the legacy Columns tab + GroupedColumnsTab write path for apiInput, but the `nodeType === API_INPUT ? <GroupedColumnsTab .../> : <ColumnsTab .../>` ternary was not collapsed. As a consequence the `GroupedColumnsTab` import (line 25) is now used only inside dead code within this file.
evidence: Line 73: NO_COLUMNS_TAB = new Set([NODE_TYPES.API_INPUT, ...]). Line 666: showColumnsTab = isKnownNodeType && !isInstance && !NO_COLUMNS_TAB.has(nodeType) -> false for API_INPUT. Line 1020: `{activeTab === "columns" && showColumnsTab ? (` gates entry. Line 1021: `nodeType === NODE_TYPES.API_INPUT ? (<GroupedColumnsTab .../>) : (<ColumnsTab .../>)` — the true arm is statically unreachable because entering the block proves showColumnsTab===true => nodeType !== API_INPUT. Confirmed apiInputBundle3aContract.test.tsx asserts the columns button is NOT rendered for apiInput (queryByRole 'columns' -> null), and no test renders GroupedColumnsTab through NodePanel. grep confirms GroupedColumnsTab appears in NodePanel.tsx only at the import (25), the explanatory comment (65), and the dead JSX arm (1022).
est_reduction: ~9 LOC (collapse the ternary at 1020-1036 to render <ColumnsTab/> directly, and drop the now-unused GroupedColumnsTab import at line 25)
behavior_preservation: Removing the unreachable API_INPUT arm and rendering <ColumnsTab/> directly is behavior-preserving: the arm never runs for any node type (API_INPUT can never reach showColumnsTab===true), so no rendered output changes for any node. The GroupedColumnsTab import becomes unused once the arm is deleted; GroupedColumnsTab is still imported/used by its own module and other call sites, so only the NodePanel import line is removed.
